chunk_map.heading: An agent's instructions are not the agent

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L4 "They run it" (colleague, named in same sentence); L6 "All of that" resolves to the three items just listed (memory, corrections, calls); L8 "the others" = the wider team in the same sentence. Closest: L6 "All of that" stays inside because the antecedent list is the preceding sentence.
No pointer at another file or slide by position; grep above/below/opening lecture in body: 0 hits. Closest L8 "a proposal to the wider team" is generic, not a callback.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No "the X you did/saw/caught" beat reference. Closest L4 "Your agent works well for you" is a scenario premise, not a dead beat; L6 "your interviews and tickets" are the reader's own work, not a module beat.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.

rules_evaluated.evidence: L4-8 three paragraphs each carry a claim; the slide's claim is L6 "The page was never where the work lived." Not a wait-state slide.
Header L1 "An agent's instructions are not the agent" is borne out by L6 (instructions page vs memory, corrections, calls). Closest: L8 shifts to a proposal consequence, still the same claim applied.

No Not-X-Not-Y-Z, no number+retraction, no self-grading superlative. Closest: L6 three-part list "in the memory... in every correction... in your calls" is a list of three concrete named things, not an anaphora triple or empty-leg verb triplet. L8 "who corrects it, and how they learn to read" is a concrete trio.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No repo dialect: body vocabulary is agent, instructions, memory, proposal, team. Maintainer "Agent file" note is outside body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -c '\*\*' on body L1-9 -> 0; no bold, within budget.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: single slide file composed by the host deck; presence is the including lecture's concern

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no Phase/Step headers; check-slide-numbering.js --file -> OK exit 0

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: check-slide-deixis.js --file -> OK exit 0; grep above|below|top of|further down|see below on body -> 0 hits.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Lecture heading L1 "An agent's instructions are not the agent" is a claim, as lectures require.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Three paragraphs, each adds a distinct move: L4 scenario, L6 where the work lives, L8 consequence for a proposal. Closest to a restating kicker is L8, but it adds the proposal consequence (what others feed, who corrects, how they learn to read) not held earlier.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Maintainer STATUS L12 shows an APT101 rewrite, not a header rename over inherited bullets; covering body, header L1 promises instructions vs agent and all three paragraphs answer it.

notes: One-slide file, no title lede; single chunk.
